# Version 3.0.0
> **First SkiaSharp 3 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.0.0-preview.5.4)

> **Superseded by [3.116.0](3.116.0.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 3.116.0.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.0.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.0 previews a major engine and platform refresh with a streamlined modern API. The release adds modern span-based APIs and expanded desktop, mobile, and web support. Review the breaking changes before migrating from 2.x.

## Breaking Changes

- **Legacy obsolete APIs were removed** — Members that were previously marked obsolete are no longer available. Update callers to the replacement APIs before moving from SkiaSharp 2.x. ([#2539](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2539))

## Engine

- **Skia and bundled graphics dependencies were refreshed** — Updates the renderer and bundled image and text dependencies for the 3.0 preview line. — ❤️ [@Redth](https://github.com/Redth) ([#2829](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2829), [#3026](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3026), [#2582](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2582), [#2622](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2622), [#2583](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2583))

## API Surface

- **New drawing and data APIs** — Adds SKBlender, Skottie animation building, raw shaders, picture recording APIs, and span-based overloads for common graphics operations. — ❤️ [@Youssef1313](https://github.com/Youssef1313) ([#2830](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2830), [#2630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2630), [#2748](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2748), [#2883](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2883), [#2879](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2879), [#2889](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2889), [#2949](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2949))

## Platform

- **Platform view and GPU support expanded** — Adds accelerated WinUI and WPF elements, modernizes Mac Catalyst rendering, and improves WebAssembly and Uno view support. — ❤️ [@gmurray81](https://github.com/gmurray81), [@Youssef1313](https://github.com/Youssef1313) ([#2733](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2733), [#2317](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2317), [#2747](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2747), [#2598](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2598), [#2970](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2970), [#2918](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2918))

## Bug Fixes

- **Rendering and resource handling fixes** — Corrects Metal snapshots, XAML canvas behavior, cloned paint disposal, text kerning, and pixel access behavior. — ❤️ [@taublast](https://github.com/taublast), [@jeromelaban](https://github.com/jeromelaban), [@jeremy-visionaid](https://github.com/jeremy-visionaid), [@pdjonov](https://github.com/pdjonov) ([#2804](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2804), [#2854](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2854), [#2904](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2904), [#2858](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2858), [#2609](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/2609))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.0

Refreshes bundled HarfBuzz and aligns generated bindings with the modernized 3.0 platform and interop work.
